title: Retrieve broadly. Rank carefully. Deliver reliably.
discipline: Recommendation / learning to rank / ML systems
summary: A large-scale session recommender with multi-source retrieval, objective-specific ranking, controlled feature studies, and verified batch delivery. Public reference training and bounded evidence review serve different reproducibility needs.
scope: The selected Python command runs the existing public reference review and synthetic recommendation report. Optional Node checks exercise the report interface. The existing native training and full-data reference workflows remain available, separate from the later private neural release.
private_boundary: Raw event populations, private embeddings, current neural checkpoints, exact selected blend rules, complete prediction rows, and private AWS orchestration remain excluded.

cards.title: Keep retrieval coverage separate from ranking quality.
cards.decision: Measure what candidate generation can reach and what the final ranked list actually recovers.
cards.boundary: An increased candidate ceiling does not establish an improved top-20 result.

cards.title: Make feature gains a matched comparison.
cards.decision: Compare controlled representations on the same temporal population and preserve paired uncertainty estimates.
cards.boundary: The local feature-study metric is not the externally recorded release score.

cards.title: Recover training without losing model identity.
cards.decision: Use native model reloads, full-query ranking metrics, and atomic iteration checkpoints.
cards.boundary: This source does not certify every upstream private retrieval artifact.

cards.title: Offer a reference workflow without the private recipe.
cards.decision: Provide explicit review, native training, verification, and resource-bounded full-data research modes.
cards.boundary: The public reference is not an exact reconstruction of the later neural-similarity release.
